Wrath of the Mummy#000.src: Talk to Ormrod in the desert of {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Wrath of the Mummy#002.src: I live in this camp by choice. A curse follows me... and now trouble starts wherever I go. I left civilization and made camp in the desert, where I could do no more harm.
Wrath of the Mummy#002.dst: 저는 스스로 이 야영지에 살아요. 저주가 저를 따라다녀서... 제가 가는 곳마다 사달이 나죠. 그래서 문명을 떠나 더는 해를 끼치지 않을 사막에 자리를 잡았어요.
Wrath of the Mummy#002.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#003.src: I do miss the comforts of {p} some days, though... you look like a learned adventurer. If I asked you to investigate this curse, perhaps you could help me rid myself of it?
Wrath of the Mummy#003.dst: 그래도 어떤 날은 {p}의 안락함이 그립네요... 당신은 배운 모험가처럼 보이는군요. 이 저주를 조사해 달라고 부탁하면, 저를 벗어나게 해 줄 수 있을까요?
Wrath of the Mummy#003.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#004.src: It all started when I discovered an old tomb in the North of the desert. Upon entering it, the ground started shaking and I heard inhuman screams coming from deeper within.
Wrath of the Mummy#004.dst: 모든 건 제가 사막 북쪽에서 오래된 무덤을 발견하면서 시작됐어요. 안으로 들어서자 땅이 흔들리더니, 더 깊은 곳에서 사람의 것이 아닌 비명이 들려왔죠.
Wrath of the Mummy#004.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#005.src: I ran as fast as I could, learning later the tomb housed the remains of an ancient Mummy... which I accidentally awoke. If the Mummy could be put back to rest, perhaps the curse would go away.
Wrath of the Mummy#005.dst: 죽을힘을 다해 달아났고, 나중에야 그 무덤에 고대 미라의 유해가 있었다는 걸 알았어요... 제가 실수로 깨운 거죠. 그 미라를 다시 잠재울 수 있다면 저주도 사라질지 몰라요.
Wrath of the Mummy#005.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#006.src: I have heard of a scholar in {p}, Achper, who may know more about the tomb. I am reluctant to return to the city, in case my presence hurts anyone else.
Wrath of the Mummy#006.dst: {p}에 Achper라는 학자가 있는데 그 무덤에 대해 더 알지도 몰라요. 제 존재가 또 누군가를 다치게 할까 봐 도시로 돌아가긴 꺼려지네요.
Wrath of the Mummy#006.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#007.src: If you would truly like to help, you should start by talking to him.
Wrath of the Mummy#007.dst: 정말 돕고 싶다면, 먼저 그에게 말을 걸어 보세요.
Wrath of the Mummy#007.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#008.src: Talk to Achper in {p} about the curse at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Wrath of the Mummy#009.src: If I know about mummies? Of course! I've spent my entire life studying them!
Wrath of the Mummy#009.dst: 미라를 아느냐고요? 당연하죠! 평생 미라만 연구했는걸요!
Wrath of the Mummy#009.speaker: Achper

Wrath of the Mummy#010.src: They usually are very hard to reach, hidden in their tomb... and they don't like being disturbed.
Wrath of the Mummy#010.dst: 보통은 무덤 깊이 숨어 있어 접근하기 어렵죠... 게다가 방해받는 걸 아주 싫어해요.
Wrath of the Mummy#010.speaker: Achper

Wrath of the Mummy#011.src: I have heard of the curse that follows Ormrod, and the only way to remove its effects would be to kill the mummy.
Wrath of the Mummy#011.dst: Ormrod를 따라다니는 저주 얘기는 들었어요. 그 효과를 없애는 유일한 방법은 미라를 죽이는 겁니다.
Wrath of the Mummy#011.speaker: Achper

Wrath of the Mummy#012.src: The tomb lies in the North of the desert, but be very careful!
Wrath of the Mummy#012.dst: 무덤은 사막 북쪽에 있어요, 하지만 아주 조심하세요!
Wrath of the Mummy#012.speaker: Achper

Wrath of the Mummy#013.src: Mummies aren't known to be weak... especially that one. It's demonic... pure evil, It's easily one of the most powerful specimens I've encountered.
Wrath of the Mummy#013.dst: 미라는 결코 약한 존재가 아니에요... 특히 그놈은요. 악마 같고... 순수한 악이죠. 제가 마주친 것 중 가장 강한 개체에 쉽게 듭니다.
Wrath of the Mummy#013.speaker: Achper

Wrath of the Mummy#014.src: On top of that, the Creden Tibus bandit clan have been ransacking the tombs around the desert. You might run into trouble with them, so be prepared.
Wrath of the Mummy#014.dst: 게다가 Creden Tibus 도적단이 사막 곳곳의 무덤을 털고 다녀요. 그들과 부딪칠 수도 있으니 준비하세요.
Wrath of the Mummy#014.speaker: Achper

Wrath of the Mummy#015.src: Attempt to enter the Mummy's tomb at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Wrath of the Mummy#016.src: Stop! If you're thinking about looting the tomb, you're too late. The Creden Tibus have laid claim here, and you're not getting past.
Wrath of the Mummy#016.dst: 멈춰! 무덤을 털 생각이라면 이미 늦었어. 여긴 Creden Tibus가 차지했고, 넌 못 지나가.
Wrath of the Mummy#016.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#017.src: Mummy? Curse? I don't know anything about that, but I can't let you in - how do I know you won't just grab the gold?
Wrath of the Mummy#017.dst: 미라? 저주? 그런 건 하나도 몰라. 어쨌든 못 들여보내 - 네가 금을 안 챙긴다는 보장이 어딨어?
Wrath of the Mummy#017.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#018.src: Unless... look. I've been waiting to get my hands on some pink wool, and the only shop that sells it has just been restocked.
Wrath of the Mummy#018.dst: 아니면... 이봐. 내가 분홍 양털을 손에 넣고 싶어 벼르고 있었는데, 그걸 파는 유일한 가게에 방금 물건이 들어왔대.
Wrath of the Mummy#018.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#019.src: Trouble is, the shop's over in {p} and I'm stuck guarding this tomb. If you go and grab me some before it sells out, I can look the other way.
Wrath of the Mummy#019.dst: 문제는 그 가게가 {p}에 있고 난 여기 무덤을 지켜야 한다는 거지. 다 팔리기 전에 좀 구해다 주면, 못 본 척해 줄게.
Wrath of the Mummy#019.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#020.src: You can take my wagon over there, but you'll have to make your own way back. Give me [{~} Pink Wool] and I'll let you through.
Wrath of the Mummy#020.dst: 저기 내 수레를 타고 가도 돼, 돌아올 땐 알아서 와야 하지만. [{~} Pink Wool]을 주면 통과시켜 줄게.
Wrath of the Mummy#020.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#021.src: Use the bandit's wagon at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to get to {p}.

Wrath of the Mummy#022.src: Bring back [{~} Pink Wool] to the bandit at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Wrath of the Mummy#023.src: Well, whaddya know? You got some Pink Wool! Okay, hand it here and I'll look the other way and let you into the tomb.
Wrath of the Mummy#023.dst: 야, 이것 봐라? 분홍 양털을 구해 왔네! 좋아, 이리 넘겨. 못 본 척하고 무덤에 들여보내 줄게.
Wrath of the Mummy#023.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#024.src: Just don't touch any of the gold, hmm? And if I were you, I wouldn't go in too deep.
Wrath of the Mummy#024.dst: 금엔 손대지 마, 알았지? 그리고 내가 너라면 너무 깊이는 안 들어가.
Wrath of the Mummy#024.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#025.src: The clan was going to explore further inside, but the sounds...
Wrath of the Mummy#025.dst: 우리 패거리도 더 안쪽까지 가 보려 했는데, 그 소리가...
Wrath of the Mummy#025.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#026.src: Anyway, I'll still let you inside if you want. Just remember, if anyone asks, this conversation never happened.
Wrath of the Mummy#026.dst: 아무튼 원하면 들여보내 줄게. 다만 누가 묻거든, 이 대화는 없었던 거야.
Wrath of the Mummy#026.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#027.src: Enter the tomb at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and kill the Mummy.

Wrath of the Mummy#028.src: Bring [{~} Mummy's Bandage] to Ormrod at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Wrath of the Mummy#029.src: Hello, again... have you had any luck?
Wrath of the Mummy#029.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#030.src: Those are the Mummy's bandages?! You did it? My curse is finally lifted!
Wrath of the Mummy#030.dst: 그게 미라의 붕대인가요?! 해낸 거예요? 드디어 저주가 풀렸어요!
Wrath of the Mummy#030.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#031.src: I can't thank you enough! As a reward, take this rag I got from the Mummy when I entered the tomb.
Wrath of the Mummy#031.dst: 뭐라 감사해야 할지! 보답으로, 제가 무덤에 들어갔을 때 미라에게서 얻은 이 천을 받으세요.
Wrath of the Mummy#031.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#032.src: I am not strong enough to wear it, but I'm sure you are! Take these emeralds too, that's the least I can do!
Wrath of the Mummy#032.dst: 저는 그걸 걸칠 만큼 강하지 않지만 당신은 분명 강하죠! 이 에메랄드도 받아요, 이 정도는 해야죠!
Wrath of the Mummy#032.speaker: Ormrod
